race.comment: PARMALEE (9) resumes as the horse with the most appealing upside, having debuted in Open grade at Ascot when sixth, beaten just under three lengths, after being near the top of betting. She trialled at Albany two weeks ago, the first-time blinkers are a meaningful gear change. CARTIER GLOW (4) brings the most exposed recent consistency, with three placings from five starts and a close Bunbury third before his last-start fourth as favourite. The 10-day back-up is the small reservation, but his race fitness and 3kg claim keep him right in the contest. IS THIS THING ON (8) can rebound third-up after being bumped last start, with her Kalgoorlie third a much better guide. DASHING LIZZY (7) is the debut runner of interest after trialling at Albany, finishing third, and her family gives enough substance to treat her as a genuine place hope first time out. MY TESTIMONY (12) is worth keeping safe.
